line_items.work_text: Improvement of Road from Charikaria Bridge to Sankardev Path at Charikaria River Bridge Approach near Dhakuakhana Chariali for Mitigation of Disasters through Vetiver-Enhanced Slope Stabilization and Gabion Wall Integration under SDMF for the year 2025-26 in Lakhimpur District

Integrated Slope-Stabilized Road Improvement from Katharbari to KhajuaPatir Tinali via Krishnapur Chariali using RCC Cantilever Retaining Wall and Banana Fiber Geotextile-Based Bio-Mitigative Technology for Disaster Resilience in Lakhimpur District under SDMF for the year 2025-26

Improvement of Road from SH-42 to Joy Sagar Beel for Disaster Mitigation Using Short Slab Cement Concrete Pavement and Sisal Geotextile-Based Bio-Mitigative Technology in Lakhimpur District under SDMF for the year 2025-26

Strengthening and improvement of Road over Brahmaputra Dyke from Tekeliphuta to Lutachur using Jute Geotextile and Geo- bags for Mitigation of Piping-Induced Flood Risk under SDMF for the year 2025-26 in Lakhimpur District

narrative: The 16th Appraisal committee held on 23rd December, 2025 recommended the proposals and directed to place it before the SEC.
